findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/lights-out.js::run-dir discard defeated by lock artifacts in the mint refusal path
findings.title: Run-dir discard defeated by lock artifacts in the mint refusal path
findings.action: Keep the non-recursive discard (FAFF-1280 rule); the schema check runs before any write and a foreign lock file is not this mint's to delete
findings.disposition_rationale: mutateLedgerUnderLock validates before it writes, so a schema refusal leaves the dir empty; a lock-exhaustion failure in a freshly exclusive-created dir means a foreign holder owns any lock file, which the non-recursive helper correctly leaves and reports on stderr. Same behaviour as init-self-drain and spec Decision 5.

occurrences.title: Run-dir discard defeated by lock artifacts in the mint refusal path

findings.title: Non-JSON mint refusal prints no banner
findings.action: Print pf.banner before the refusal line, or accept the single-line form
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec names init-self-drain's single stderr line as the model and the --json shape as the contract; a banner would diverge from the sibling and add output the spec does not ask for.
